indexing.excludedFrameNumbers: One-based source frame numbers for human-readable production notes.

instructions.use: Approved for production unless an individual frame is excluded.
instructions.dont-use: Do not ship this asset or use it as a reference/substitute.
instructions.frameOrder: Repack frames in this exact source-index order before applying exclusions.

assets.name: ash hound
assets.notes:
Name: Orion
Acquisition: given to you after 700 deaths
Effect: occasionally barks and staggers enemy
Flavor: "He has been waiting for you to get back up."
Mechanics notes: We need to make sure deaths are recording on offline idling.

assets.name: ashwing vulture
assets.notes:
Name: Morrow
Acquisition: bought from Walsh the traveling merchant for 500k
Effect: randomly heals you to full every once in a while
Flavor: "Patient, but not for the reason you hoped."

assets.name: barrow lynx
assets.notes:
Name: Marlowe
Acquisition: Unassigned; currently marked don't-use.
Effect: Cosmetic only.
Flavor: "The barrow was locked from the inside."

assets.name: bear
assets.notes:
Name: Bramble
Acquisition: Rare reward from Act 1 boss hunts.
Effect: Occasionally growls when a boss appears; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "He has never once considered being smaller."

assets.name: boar
assets.notes:
Name: Turnip
Acquisition: Awarded after completing 10,000 farming levels.
Effect: Occasionally digs up a small pile of gold.
Flavor: "He found it. You may submit an appeal."

assets.name: bog possum
assets.notes:
Name: Binjamin
Acquisition: Given for getting level 75 scrapper mastery
Effect: occasionally finds a random item for you
Flavor: "Don't touch my garbage"

assets.name: boneplate boar
assets.notes:
Name: Gristle
Acquisition: Rare Act 3 Desolation drop.
Effect: Occasionally staggers a normal enemy for a short duration.
Flavor: "Half boar, half barricade, entirely in the way."

assets.name: chainback hyena
assets.notes:
Name: Rattle
Acquisition: 0.002% chance to find on a bounty hunt
Effect: Gives 10% defense.
Flavor: "He wears the chain for style."

assets.name: cinder bat
assets.notes:
Name: Kindle
Acquisition: Rarely found after defeating burning enemies in Act 2.
Effect: Adds 25% fire damage.
Flavor: "It sleeps upside down and occasionally burns it's den."

assets.name: coin mimic magenta keyed
assets.notes:
Name: Penny
Acquisition: Unassigned; currently marked don't-use.
Effect: Cosmetic only.
Flavor: "A terrible investment with excellent teeth."

assets.name: combat bloodroot homunculus
assets.notes:
Name: Hemlock
Acquisition: Found after getting 2k kills in a single blood rite.
Effect: attacks every 5 seconds, always bleeds, 10% of your damage.
Attack Frame: 2
Flavor: "It grows best when nobody asks what is in the soil."

assets.name: combat gravebell ram
assets.notes:
Name: Knell
Acquisition: Awarded for defeating 250 delve guardians.
Effect: Charges every 5 seconds for 8% of your damage and briefly staggers.
Attack Frame: 2
Flavor: "Watch your knees."

assets.name: combat stormwing moth
assets.notes:
Name: Vesper
Acquisition: shows up after using 15 divine shards
Effect: afflicts with neurotoxin every 5 seconds and does 5% of your dmg on that attack
Attack Frame: 2
Flavor: "Sent by the Gods"

assets.name: combat thornback basilisk
assets.notes:
Name: Cindercone
Acquisition: found by killing 500k monsters in act 5 desolation
Effect: shoots a fireball every 2.5 seconds for 5% of your damage. reuse fireball animation from sorc
Attack Frame: 2
Flavor: "Warm to the touch. Regrettably, so is everything near it."

assets.name: combat voidjaw mimic
assets.notes:
Name: Pockets
Acquisition: 5% chance to get this from a mimic chest during a delve
Effect: attacks every 5 seconds with a reduced 'hex' effect, applying the status effect, increasing damage by 15%.
Attack Frame: 2
Flavor: "Eww it has legs."

assets.name: crypt raven
assets.notes:
Name: Toll
Acquisition: Very rarely found when farming act 3
Effect: Occasionally spots a little extra gold after a kill.
Flavor: "Counts every grave. Refuses to explain why."

assets.name: crystal fawn
assets.notes:
Name: Prism
Acquisition: Found after activating 1500 shrines.
Effect: Occasionally causes a magic item to upgrade to a rare.
Flavor: "Do not drop."

assets.name: eagle
assets.notes:
Name: Kest
Acquisition: Rare expedition completion reward.
Effect: Occasionally circles when a bounty target appears; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "Judges your pathing from a professional altitude."

assets.name: eyebloom familiar magenta keyed
assets.notes:
Name: Iris
Acquisition: can be purchased by merchants in the delve occasionally. costs 5 million gold
Effect: Occasionally freezes an enemy for the duration of the fight. No bosses or delve guardians or bounty contracts
Flavor: "It has seen what is behind you."

assets.name: grave scorpion
assets.notes:
Name: Clicks
Acquisition: Can be bought from the tinker for 250k
Effect: poisons very rarely
Flavor: "It is not waving."

assets.name: graveclaw spider
assets.notes:
Name: Thread
Acquisition: found in act 1 extremely rarely no difficulty requirement; if the player choses to farm deso act 1 normal it should take 30 hours kind of rarity. easier to get in later rarities
Effect: No additional effect specified.
Flavor: "Has eight legs and still trips over all of them."

assets.name: hollowhorn ram
assets.notes:
Name: Thimble
Acquisition: Extremely rarely found anywhere while farming
Effect: +5% damage
Flavor: "The horn is hollow. The opinions are not."

assets.name: horned mire lizard
assets.notes:
Name: Stump
Acquisition: Sometimes rarely shows up in the town shop for 5k
Effect: Adds 5 hp regen.
Flavor: "Proudly unqualified."

assets.name: hound
assets.notes:
Name: Patch
Acquisition: Given after completing the first bounty chain.
Effect: Occasionally barks at bounty targets; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "Good nose. Questionable sources."

assets.name: idle ashen fox
assets.notes:
Name: Ember
Acquisition: mastery level 75 boss hunting.
Effect: +75% status effectiveness.
Flavor: "Steals warm seats and nothing else you can prove."

assets.name: idle bone crab
assets.notes:
Name: Porter
Acquisition: found after killing the level 60 delve guardian
Effect: carries an extra delve item out if you have him on when you go in
Flavor: "All luggage is technically shell luggage."

assets.name: idle candle snail
assets.notes:
Name: Tallow
Acquisition: found extremely rarely when crushing jars in delves; can be found just by auto-delving or idle queue delves but very very low chance, days of work
Effect: occassionally burns opponent
Flavor: "Not fast, but never late for a vigil."

assets.name: idle cave axolotl
assets.notes:
Name: Glim
Acquisition: Rare jar or event find in deep delves.
Effect: Gives 10% more energy shield.
Flavor: "No thoughts. Several gills."

assets.name: idle clockwork chick
assets.notes:
Name: Peep
Acquisition: given to you after you get your first item tinkered 5 times
Effect: enhances fully tinkered items by 5%
Flavor: "It believes every loose screw is food."

assets.name: idle dusk bat
assets.notes:
Name: Pip
Acquisition: Town shop purchase after nightfall for 25k gold.
Effect: Cosmetic idle companion.
Flavor: "Small enough to be brave by accident."

flying

assets.name: idle ember gecko
assets.notes:
Name: Toast
Acquisition: Found after maintaining Burn on a boss for 30 seconds.
Effect: Occasionally warms the hero after combat; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "He is not burnt. He is finished."

assets.name: idle frost ferret
assets.notes:
Name: Nips
Acquisition: Rarely found in jars during Act 5 delves.
Effect: Gives 5% crit chance.
Flavor: "Cold hands. Colder pockets."

assets.name: idle ghost cat
assets.notes:
Name: Mewriel
Acquisition: Appears after the hero dies nine times in one session.
Effect: Sometimes fades out and returns somewhere inconvenient but will have an item.
Flavor: "Still expects the door opened."

assets.name: idle glass frog
assets.notes:
Name: Window
Acquisition: Extremely rarely dropped from Act 1 farming.
Effect: Gives 3% extra HP
Flavor: "Easy to lose. Difficult to stop hearing."

assets.name: idle grave mouse
assets.notes:
Name: Crumb
Acquisition: Rewarded for lvl75 farming mastery
Effect: Gives 20% magic find.
Flavor: "Technically a grave robber. Practically very small."

assets.name: idle iron beetle
assets.notes:
Name: Buckle
Acquisition: Purchased from the Tinker for 450k gold.
Effect: Gives 5% sunder.
Flavor: "Built like a shield. Thinks like a spoon."

assets.name: idle moon hare
assets.notes:
Name: Lumen
Acquisition: Exttremely rare any desolation hell act.
Effect: Adds 350 recovery.
Flavor: "Only visible when it wants credit."

assets.name: idle moss turtle
assets.notes:
Name: Patio
Acquisition: Found after sitting on the game paused for an hour without closing.
Effect: +25% xp gain
Flavor: "A garden with somewhere to be eventually."

assets.name: idle mushroom sprite
assets.notes:
Name: Button
Acquisition: Rarely sprouts after defeating poisoned enemies.
Effect: Occasionally releases spores. Spores cause the enemy to miss 10% attacks
Flavor: "Probably edible. This is not advice."

assets.name: idle plague crow
assets.notes:
Name: Sneeze
Acquisition: Given to you after choosing your first mastery in epoch.
Effect: +50% gold find.
Flavor: "That's his lucky coin"

assets.name: idle rune owl
assets.notes:
Name: Serif
Acquisition: Reward for reading every unlocked Journal entry.
Effect: Sometimes marks a target for death. Giving you 10% culling strike. half for bosses.
Flavor: "Corrects your pronunciation by staring harder."

assets.name: idle silver koi wisp
assets.notes:
Name: Ripple
Acquisition: Extremely rare from anywhere farming.
Effect: Regenerates 1% energy shield per second.
Flavor: "Swims through air because water was too conventional."

flying

assets.name: idle thorn hedgehog
assets.notes:
Name: Needles
Acquisition: Rare Act 3 farming drop.
Effect: Gives you 15% thorns.
Flavor: "Pet carefully. Or delegate."

assets.name: idle tiny mimic
assets.notes:
Name: Lunchbox
Acquisition: Very rare drop from a defeated mimic chest.
Effect: Gives an item a lucky roll sometimes.
Flavor: "Pack a snack. Become the snack."

assets.name: ironback rat
assets.notes:
Name: Scraps
Acquisition: Purchased from the Tinker after salvaging 3,000 items.
Effect: Occasionally retrieves a tiny amount of salvage.
Flavor: "Nothing is junk if you chew it long enough."

assets.name: longhaired black cat
assets.notes:
Name: Ophelia
Acquisition: Reward for your first town visit.
Effect: Cosmetic idle companion.
Flavor: "She just keeps yelling at you, nobody knows what she wants."

assets.name: lynx
assets.notes:
Name: Socks
Acquisition: Rare bounty hunt companion reward.
Effect: Cosmetic idle companion.
Flavor: "Silent hunter. Loud opinions about breakfast."

assets.name: miniature griffin
assets.notes:
Name: Pipsqueak
Acquisition: Expensive Walsh inventory item for 2 million gold.
Effect: Slightly increases the magnitudes of unique items.
Flavor: "Majesty, now available in travel size."

assets.name: mire crocodile
assets.notes:
Name: Boots
Acquisition: Rare Act 3 swamp encounter reward.
Effect: Greatly increases the magnitude of rare and magic boot rolls.
Flavor: "Named for the last thing it ate."

assets.name: panther
assets.notes:
Name: Velvet
Acquisition: Reward for completing 100 hunts without abandoning one.
Effect: Occasionally prowls behind the target; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "The darkness has started purring."

assets.name: pygmy horned goat
assets.notes:
Name: Taxes
Acquisition: Town shop gold sink for 750k gold.
Effect: Periodically eats a small amount of gold; provides no benefit.
Flavor: "Some costs are recurring."

assets.name: raven
assets.notes:
Name: Quill
Acquisition: Given after discovering 25 unique items.
Effect: Occasionally lands near newly dropped loot; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "Keeps a list. You are on it twice."

assets.name: reliquary jackal
assets.notes:
Name: Votive
Acquisition: Rare reward for fully leveling 75% of relics.
Effect: Makes relic activation last 20 seconds longer.
Flavor: "Guards holy things and one suspicious stick."

assets.name: river otter
assets.notes:
Name: Pebble
Acquisition: Rarely found on after killing a boss.
Effect: Cosmetic idle companion.
Flavor: "Carries one rock. Rejects all upgrades."

assets.name: runic squirrel
assets.notes:
Name: Cache
Acquisition: Rarely appears after spending a large amount of gem shards. This includes crafting and fortune mill
Effect: Occasionally finds an extra gem shard during combat.
Flavor: "Saving for winter, one apocalypse at a time."

assets.name: sable capybara
assets.notes:
Name: Duke
Acquisition: Town shop luxury purchase for 1 million gold.
Effect: Cosmetic idle companion.
Flavor: "Untroubled by the Everdeep. Mildly troubled by stairs."

assets.name: serpent
assets.notes:
Name: Noodle
Acquisition: Rare poison-skill mastery reward.
Effect: Occasionally hisses when Poison is applied; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "Long, judgmental, and technically portable."

assets.name: shade serpent
assets.notes:
Name: Smudge
Acquisition: Extremely rarely found in the Everdeep.
Effect: Occasionally fully blocks an attack.
Flavor: "Escaped from the corner of your eye."

assets.name: shadow raccoon
assets.notes:
Name: Lockpick
Acquisition: Rarely found when opening any chests, including stuff in delves. Extremely rare.
Effect: Collects essence over time.
Flavor: "Wash your loot before equipping it."

assets.name: tatterwing vulture
assets.notes:
Name: Scrim
Acquisition: Rare Act 5 Desolation drop.
Effect: Gives 0.25% life on hit.
Flavor: "Optimistic about your survival in a very specific way."

assets.name: wolf
assets.notes:
Name: Moss
Acquisition: Reward for clearing every normal act with one character.
Effect: Occasionally howls when entering a new act; cosmetic only.
Flavor: "A loyal companion and an unreliable pillow."

assets.name: wyvern
assets.notes:
Name: Cinder
Acquisition: Very rare endgame Journey reward.
Effect: Occasionally breathes a harmless spark after combat.
Flavor: "A dragon, according to its own paperwork."

assets.name: Boilerback Mole
assets.notes:
Name: Kettle
Acquisition: Purchased from the Tinker for 800k gold.
Effect: Sometimes digs up a gear that can be traded to the tinker for an extra item tinker.
Flavor: "Runs hot. Digs cold."

assets.name: Clockwork Scarab
assets.notes:
Name: Clicker
Acquisition: Purchased from the Tinker after crafting 100 items.
Effect: Reduces -1% chance to destroy an item per 5%. So 50% chance to destroy an item would turn into 40%.
Flavor: "Has six legs and seven maintenance schedules."

assets.name: Gearwing Raven
assets.notes:
Name: Ratchet
Acquisition: Tinker reward for fully upgrading the Fortune Mill.
Effect: Halves energy usage for the fortune mill.
Flavor: "Nevermore, unless properly lubricated."

assets.name: Rivet Hound
assets.notes:
Name: Socket
Acquisition: A rare schematic for this pet drops in Everdeep. Costs 5 million to build.
Effect: Can use a fully tinkered unique in your Vault and gives you the special line.
Flavor: "Good machine. Best wrench retriever."

assets.name: Springtail Lizard
assets.notes:
Name: Coil
Acquisition: Schematic randomly found throughout the game on kill. 20 of each gem shard to build by the tinker.
Effect: Occasionally performs an unnecessary calibration hop that causes you to critical strike 5 times in a row.
Flavor: "Precision engineering with no brakes."
